name: Adachi Aoi
source: [url=/c44220]Yuuma's[/url] friendly, curious and energetic classmate who talks in an odd way. Aoi is an ace at sports and always wears spats under her skirt. She sometimes acts like a fool but in reality gets excellent grades. She quickly gets hungry and as such it's part of her routine to try and take Yuuma's lunchbox. She also loves cute things.
